hero.subtitle: Curated Camera Rental Studio & Creative Hub
hero.desc: Rent curated Fujifilm cameras, cinema glass, and a 360m² cyclorama studio in Da Nang. Transparent daily rates, ready-to-shoot kits, and preloaded film simulation recipes.
hero.badge2: Local delivery in Da Nang & Hoi An

about.desc: We believe creating memorable photos and videos should feel joyful, accessible, and effortless. Whether you're exploring Da Nang, café hopping in Hoi An, or shooting lookbooks, our cameras are fully tested, charged to 100%, and ready to shoot.
about.quote: “Focus on your vision — we take care of the gear.”

services.desc: From pocket-friendly travel cameras to a 360m² cyclorama studio and full-scale commercial video production.

equipment.desc: All packages are ready-to-shoot complete kits: includes 2 batteries, dual charger, high-speed memory card, and padded protective carry bag.
equipment.askAdvice: Unsure which camera to pick? Chat on Zalo for quick recommendations!

studio.desc: Full white and black cyclorama, high ceilings, 3-phase power, and dedicated podcast talking-head set. Flexible hourly and daily bookings for creators and brands.
